title: Orble
premise: Line up a shot. Let the ricochets work.
summary: Launch a limited supply of balls through Tower-inspired courses, clear orange targets, and make your core ability count.
about: Aim into a course and let the ball bounce through its targets. Plan around the limited number of balls, look for useful angles, and collect bonuses along the route.
Courses combine targets, enemies, boosters, and naturally splitting multiball. Different cores bring different abilities, giving you another decision to make during a shot.

features.title: Every shot has a route
features.text: Read the angles and use ricochets to reach targets beyond a direct line.

features.title: Targets and bonuses
features.text: Clear orange targets and collect pink bonuses and green powers as you work through a course.

features.title: A core to play around
features.text: Choose a core and use its ability at the moment that suits your shot.

steps.title: Choose your angle
steps.text: Aim with the pointer or angle slider. Consider where the first bounce will send the ball.

steps.title: Launch and react
steps.text: Release the shot and follow its route. Activate the core ability when it can help.

steps.title: Make the remaining balls count
steps.text: Use what you learned from the last trajectory to clear the remaining targets.

controls.action: Aim the ball; release the pointer to launch a shot.
Adjust the aim with the arrow keys, then press Enter to launch.
Bank the current shot and move on.

availability: Orble is in development. A public playable release and gameplay previews will be added when they are ready.
